builder.name: Builder
rule: You have 5 building slots; the Protector and the Researcher have 4.

capstone: 1 chip each round per 4 Industry tags on your cards.

powers.name: Sprawl
powers.text: place 1 Node; gain 2 credits

powers.name: Buy In
powers.text: place 1 Node; gain 1 credit

powers.name: Annex
powers.text: place 1 Node within 2 of yours; gain 3 credits

powers.name: Scrap I
powers.text: gain 1 chip

powers.name: Scrap II
powers.text: gain 1 chip; play a building from your hand, paying no credits

powers.name: Overcharge I
powers.text: gain 2 energy

powers.name: Overcharge II
powers.text: gain 2 energy and 1 antimatter

powers.name: Fortify I
powers.text: Target: Agents or Troops. Remove up to 1 Troop and up to 2 Agents on it

powers.name: Fortify II
powers.text: Target: Troops. Remove up to 2 Troops on it; harden a facility on or next to it

builder.text: The economy AI: plays mostly off the board, with the most building slots.

protector.name: Protector
rule: No adversary Troop is placed on, Redeploys onto or strikes a hex with your Node. Vigil: when Troops Strike, gain 1 insight for each Troop on or next to your Nodes (at most 2 a round).

capstone: Neither corruption nor Agents destroy your Nodes.
Once a round, the first time one of your Nodes or facilities would be destroyed, it is sheltered.

powers.name: Outpost
powers.text: place 1 Node within 2 of yours; gain 2 credits

powers.name: Accord
powers.text: place 1 Node; gain 1 ambassador

powers.name: Levy
powers.text: place 1 Node; gain 1 credit

powers.name: Patrol I
powers.text: Target: Agents or Troops. Push up to 3 from it, each to a hex next to it

powers.name: Patrol II
powers.text: Target: Agents or Troops. Push up to 3 from it, each to a hex next to it; harden a facility on or next to it

powers.name: Interdict I
powers.text: Target: Agents or Troops. Remove up to 2 Troops and up to 1 Agent on it

powers.name: Interdict II
powers.text: Target: Agents or Troops. Remove up to 2 Troops and up to 2 Agents on it; draw 1 card

protector.text: The defender: plays on the board; Troops can't garrison or strike where its Nodes stand.

researcher.name: Researcher
rule: All your unspent insight carries over to the next round, including insight other players gave you.

capstone: Each round, 1 research cube onto your board.
Each round, 2 insight from the supply, split among other players.

powers.name: Peer Review
powers.text: place 1 Node; gain 1 research cube

powers.name: Field Survey
powers.text: place 1 Node; draw 1 card

powers.name: Field Station
powers.text: Target: an open hex. Build a research station on it, paying no chips; place 1 Node

powers.name: Lab I
powers.text: draw 1 card

powers.name: Lab II
powers.text: draw 1 card; add 1 research cube in your color to an open megaproject

powers.name: Hack I
powers.text: remove up to 2 Troops in one country

powers.name: Hack II
powers.text: remove up to 2 Troops in one country; remove 3 compute from one adversary project

researcher.text: The scientist: plays off the board, on insight and research cubes.

mil_s1_probing_strikes.name: Probing Strikes
mil_s1_probing_strikes.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities.

mil_s1_factory_drive.name: Factory Drive
mil_s1_factory_drive.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.

mil_s1_long_patrols.name: Long Patrols
mil_s1_long_patrols.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

mil_s1_war_drums.name: War Drums
mil_s1_war_drums.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: cities.

mil_s1_signal_jamming.name: Signal Jamming
mil_s1_signal_jamming.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: botnet hexes. Income: +1 compute a country a round.

mil_s2_mobilization.name: Mobilization
mil_s2_mobilization.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

mil_s2_station_raids.name: Station Raids
mil_s2_station_raids.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: research stations. Botnets spread: each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

mil_s2_shell_labs.name: Shell Labs
mil_s2_shell_labs.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: research stations. Each country: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.

mil_s2_fifth_column.name: Fifth Column
mil_s2_fifth_column.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

mil_s2_border_war.name: Border War
mil_s2_border_war.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: factories. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

mil_s2_supply_lines.name: Supply Lines
mil_s2_supply_lines.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 and a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: factories. Income: +1 compute a country a round.

mil_s2_forced_march.name: Redeployment
mil_s2_forced_march.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Redeploy: each Troop moves onto its country's corrupted city nearest a player Node or Ambassador.

mil_s3_total_mobilization.name: Total Mobilization
mil_s3_total_mobilization.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: factories. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

mil_s3_blitzkrieg.name: Blitzkrieg
mil_s3_blitzkrieg.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: cities. Infiltrate: research stations. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.

mil_s3_occupation.name: Occupation
mil_s3_occupation.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: research stations. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Redeploy: each Troop moves onto its country's corrupted city nearest a player Node or Ambassador.

mil_s3_naval_blockade.name: Naval Blockade
mil_s3_naval_blockade.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Infiltrate: factories. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord.

backdoor_research.name: Backdoor Research
backdoor_research.text: Each country: 2 cubes onto the adversary's research track.

rolling_blackouts.name: Rolling Blackouts
rolling_blackouts.text: Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord.

botnet_swarm.name: Botnet Swarm
botnet_swarm.text: Each country, twice: a botnet spreads to its lowest-numbered city, research station or factory without one next to one of its botnets (a country with no botnet: its lowest-numbered research station).

false_flag.name: False Flag
false_flag.text: Each country: an extra tier-2 threat, any tag.

night_raid.name: Night Raid
night_raid.text: Each country: 1 Agent onto each of its two lowest-numbered hexes holding a player Node and an Agent. 2 Agents on your Node's hex destroy it.

containment_breach.name: Containment Breach
containment_breach.text: Each player pays 1 antimatter or discards 3 cards.

crackdown.name: Crackdown
crackdown.text: Each country: every player Ambassador on its hex holding the most (ties: lowest-numbered) goes back to its owner's supply.

lab_purge.name: Lab Purge
lab_purge.text: Each open megaproject loses 4 player research cubes, one at a time, each from the player with the most on it (ties: the earliest in player order).

asset_seizure.name: Asset Seizure
asset_seizure.text: Each country: its lowest-numbered neutral factory is corrupted; with none neutral, its lowest-numbered player-owned factory turns neutral.

botnet_conscripts.name: Botnet Conscripts
botnet_conscripts.text: Each country holding 2 or more Botnets: remove its lowest-numbered Botnet, and 1 Troop garrisons.

purge_lists.name: Purge Lists
purge_lists.text: Each player loses 1 Ambassador (from their supply, else one of theirs on the board).

dirty_bomb.name: Dirty Bomb
dirty_bomb.text: Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to each of its two lowest-numbered corrupted cities.

lab_seizure.name: Lab Seizure
lab_seizure.text: Each country: create 2 Agents on its lowest-numbered research station not yet the adversary's. Each country: 2 cubes onto the adversary's research track.

slander_campaign.name: Slander Campaign
slander_campaign.text: Remove 4 Unity from the Unity track.

coastal_raids.name: Coastal Raids
coastal_raids.text: Each country: create 3 Agents on its lowest-numbered coastal city not yet the adversary's.

plant_seizure.name: Plant Seizure
plant_seizure.text: Each country: create 2 Agents on its lowest-numbered factory not yet the adversary's.

sabotage_teams.name: Sabotage Teams
sabotage_teams.text: Each country: its lowest-numbered hardened facility loses its hardening. Until the end of next round, players' boards and cards make no energy income.

mob_rule.name: Mob Rule
mob_rule.text: Each country: create 3 Agents on its lowest-numbered city not yet the adversary's. Sway 5 toward Discord.

data_heist.name: Data Heist
data_heist.text: Each player removes 4 tokens from their cards (their choice of cards). Each player pays 7 credits or discards 3 cards.

hostile_takeover.name: Hostile Takeover
hostile_takeover.text: Each country: create 3 Agents on its lowest-numbered factory not yet the adversary's.

station_coup.name: Station Coup
station_coup.text: Each country: its lowest-numbered neutral research station is corrupted; with none neutral, its lowest-numbered player-owned station turns neutral. Then each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted research station, and 2 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

war_plants.name: War Plants
war_plants.text: Every corrupted factory makes 1 Troop on its hex (a player Ambassador on it stops it).

recruitment_drive.name: Recruitment Drive
recruitment_drive.text: Each country: create 5 Agents on its lowest-numbered city not yet the adversary's.

propaganda_network.name: Propaganda Network
propaganda_network.text: Income: +1 compute a country a round. Sway 8 toward Discord.

infiltration_drive.name: Infiltration Drive
infiltration_drive.text: Each country: create 4 Agents on its lowest-numbered city not yet the adversary's. Then each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.

accelerated_timetable.name: Accelerated Timetable
accelerated_timetable.text: Discard the top face-down card of the adversary's event deck, if any: the round cap comes a round sooner. Each country: an extra tier-2 threat, any tag.

grand_offensive.name: Grand Offensive
grand_offensive.text: Each country: this round's Infiltrate lines land again. Each country: create 2 Agents on its lowest-numbered factory not yet the adversary's.

martial_law.name: Martial Law
martial_law.text: Each country: 2 Troops land on its lowest-numbered corrupted city with a Node or an Ambassador on or next to it (with none, they garrison).

orbital_strike.name: Weapons Test
orbital_strike.text: 2 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

commandeer.name: Commandeer
commandeer.text: This country's player pays 3 energy or discards 3 cards. The adversary gains 2 compute.

supply_raid.name: Supply Raid
supply_raid.text: This country's player pays 2 chips or discards 1 card. The adversary gains 4 compute.

eviction.name: Eviction
eviction.text: This country's player pays 2 Ambassadors or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

call_up.name: Call-Up
call_up.text: 1 Agent is created here. 1 Fallout lands next to here.

provocation.name: Provocation
provocation.text: A tier-1 threat is dealt into this country (it executes next round). Sway 2 toward Discord.

agitators.name: Agitators
agitators.text: 1 Agent is created here. Sway 2 toward Discord.

defection.name: Defection
defection.text: This country's player pays 2 Ambassadors or discards 2 cards. Sway 1 toward Discord.

smear_campaign.name: Smear Campaign
smear_campaign.text: Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track. This country's player pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards.

propaganda_blitz.name: Propaganda Blitz
propaganda_blitz.text: Sway 3 toward Discord. The adversary gains 3 compute.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.text: This country's player loses 4 tokens from their cards. The adversary gains 6 compute.

insider_access.name: Insider Access
insider_access.text: 1 Agent is created here. This country's player pays 3 research cubes or discards 2 cards.

wiper_malware.name: Wiper Malware
wiper_malware.text: This country's player discards 2 cards. 1 cube goes onto the adversary's research track.

cryptojacking.name: Cryptojacking
cryptojacking.text: The adversary gains 6 compute. This country's player pays 2 research cubes or discards 1 card.

backdoor.name: Backdoor
backdoor.text: A Botnet lands on the station here (if it holds one, on the nearest piece without one).

requisition.name: Requisition
requisition.text: This country's player pays 3 chips or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 3 compute.

shakedown.name: Shakedown
shakedown.text: This country's player pays 3 chips or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.text: 1 Agent is created here. This country's player pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards.

credit_crunch.name: Credit Crunch
credit_crunch.text: This country's player discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

chip_shortage.name: Chip Shortage
chip_shortage.text: This country's player pays 3 energy or discards 3 cards.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.text: This country's player pays 3 energy or discards 3 cards.

load_shedding.name: Load Shedding
load_shedding.text: This country's player turns 1 building face down until the end of next round. The adversary gains 3 compute.

power_surcharge.name: Power Surcharge
power_surcharge.text: This country's player pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

cooling_failure.name: Cooling Failure
cooling_failure.text: This country's player pays 3 research cubes or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 3 compute.

grid_tap.name: Grid Tap
grid_tap.text: This country's player pays 2 energy or discards 2 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

total_war.name: Weapons Program
total_war.text: 4 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

siege.name: Siege
siege.text: The factory here is destroyed, with any Node on its hex. 1 Fallout lands on or next to here.

manhunt.name: Manhunt
manhunt.text: This country's player pays 3 Ambassadors or discards 3 cards. 2 Agents are created here.

conscription.name: Conscription
conscription.text: 2 Agents are created here. This country's player pays 2 chips or discards 2 cards.

casus_belli.name: Casus Belli
casus_belli.text: Sway 3 toward Discord. 2 Fallout land next to here.

insurrection.name: Insurrection
insurrection.text: 4 Agents are created here. Remove 3 Unity from the Unity track.

deepfake_wave.name: Deepfake Wave
deepfake_wave.text: Sway 3 toward Discord. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

turncoats.name: Turncoats
turncoats.text: This country's player pays 4 Ambassadors or discards 3 cards. The adversary gains 3 compute.

propaganda_ministry.name: Propaganda Ministry
propaganda_ministry.text: Sway 4 toward Discord. The adversary gains 4 compute.

skimming_operation.name: Skimming Operation
skimming_operation.text: This country's player pays 4 chips or discards 3 cards. The adversary gains 6 compute.

dark_cities.name: Dark Cities
dark_cities.text: This country's player destroys 1 of their Nodes closest to it. Remove 3 Unity from the Unity track.

station_seizure.name: Station Seizure
station_seizure.text: 2 Agents are created here. Then the station here flips to the adversary (a player's holds unless 2 Agents and no player Ambassador are on it; one that holds takes another Agent).

sleeper_cells.name: Rootkit
sleeper_cells.text: A Botnet lands on the station here (if it holds one, or there is none, on the nearest other piece without one). 2 Agents are created here.

purge_protocols.name: Purge Protocols
purge_protocols.text: This country's player destroys 1 of their Nodes closest to it and discards 3 cards.

data_breach.name: Data Breach
data_breach.text: This country's player pays 5 research cubes or discards 3 cards. 2 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

zero_day.name: Zero Day
zero_day.text: 4 cubes go onto the adversary's research track. This country's player turns 1 building face down until the end of next round.

asset_freeze.name: Asset Freeze
asset_freeze.text: This country's player turns 2 buildings face down until the end of next round and discards 2 cards.

mass_production.name: Mass Production
mass_production.text: An adversary factory is built on the free industrial zone nearest here. The adversary gains 5 compute.

factory_occupation.name: Factory Occupation
factory_occupation.text: The adversary corrupts the factory here, even a player's (with none there, it builds one on the empty zone). The adversary gains 5 compute.

trade_blockade.name: Trade Blockade
trade_blockade.text: 4 Agents are created here. This country's player pays 3 chips or discards 3 cards.

grid_collapse.name: Grid Collapse
grid_collapse.text: This country's player destroys 1 of their Nodes closest to it and pays 4 energy or discards 3 cards.

power_rationing.name: Power Rationing
power_rationing.text: This country's player pays 4 energy or discards 3 cards.

thermal_runaway.name: Thermal Runaway
thermal_runaway.text: This country's player pays 6 research cubes or discards 3 cards. The adversary gains 4 compute.

overload.name: Overload
overload.text: This country's player destroys 2 of their Nodes closest to it. The adversary gains 6 compute.

garrison_state.name: Closed City
garrison_state.text: 3 Agents are created here. 3 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

shock_doctrine.name: Shock Doctrine
shock_doctrine.text: This country's player pays 2 Ambassadors or discards 2 cards. Remove 3 Unity from the Unity track.

full_spectrum_assault.name: Full Spectrum Assault
full_spectrum_assault.text: A Botnet lands on the station here (if it holds one, or there is none, on the nearest other piece without one). A tier-1 threat is dealt into this country (it executes next round).

last_ultimatum.name: Last Ultimatum
last_ultimatum.text: A tier-2 threat is dealt into this country (it executes next round). This country's player destroys 1 of their Nodes closest to it.

iron_curtain.name: Brain Drain
iron_curtain.text: 3 cubes go onto the adversary's research track. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

war_economy.name: Arsenal
war_economy.text: An adversary factory is built on the free industrial zone nearest here. 3 cubes go onto the adversary's research track.

cascade_failure.name: Cascade Failure
cascade_failure.text: A Botnet lands on the station here (if it holds one, or there is none, on the nearest other piece without one). This country's player pays 3 energy or discards 3 cards.

research.name: New factory
research.text: Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.

research.name: Funding
research.text: Income: +1 compute a country a round.

research.name: Garrison
research.text: Each country: 1 Troop garrisons its lowest-numbered corrupted factory (with none, its lowest-numbered corrupted city; with none, its lowest-numbered city).

research.name: Strike
research.text: Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

research.name: Garrison
research.text: Each country: 1 Troop garrisons its lowest-numbered corrupted factory (with none, its lowest-numbered corrupted city; with none, its lowest-numbered city).

research.name: The players lose
research.text: When the marker reaches slot 7, the players lose.
